options.vsbetterqol.title: VS Better QOL Settings
option.vsbetterqol.saturation_bar.toolti:
Shows your saturation as a coloured outline on the hunger bar, and flashes what eating the food in your hand would add.

Using AppleSkin? Turn this off so it doesn't show twice.
option.vsbetterqol.saturation_color.tool: The colour of the saturation outline, on the hunger bar and in food tooltips.
option.vsbetterqol.food_tooltip.tooltip:
Shows how much hunger and saturation a food gives when you hover over it.

Using AppleSkin? Turn this off so it doesn't show twice.
option.vsbetterqol.effect_column.tooltip:
Shows status effects in a column in the top right with the time left.

OFF: vanilla's effect icons, and the effect list beside your inventory comes back.
option.vsbetterqol.effect_column_size.to: How big the effect column's icons and times are. 100% is the normal size.
option.vsbetterqol.armor_bar_colors.tool: Colours the armor bar by what each worn armor piece is made of.
option.vsbetterqol.durability_tooltip.to: Shows the durability of damaged items in their tooltip, without needing F3+H.
option.vsbetterqol.enchanted_book_info.t: Hold Shift on an enchanted book to read what each enchantment does.
option.vsbetterqol.shift_drag.tooltip:
Hold Shift and drag the left mouse across slots to quick-move each one.

Using Mouse Tweaks or another inventory mod that does this? Turn this off so they don't clash.
option.vsbetterqol.lower_shield.tooltip: Holds your shield lower in first person (blocking too), so it covers less of the screen.
option.vsbetterqol.lower_fire.tooltip: Shows the flames lower on your screen while you're on fire, so you can still see.
option.vsbetterqol.elytra_speed.tooltip:
Shows how fast you're flying above the hotbar while gliding with an elytra.

Green is safe, red means a crash into a wall could kill you.
option.vsbetterqol.elytra_speed_size.too: How big the elytra speed bar is. 100% is the normal size.
option.vsbetterqol.elytra_speed_position: Where the elytra speed bar shows on your screen.
gui.vsbetterqol.reroll.locked: Only Novice villagers you haven't traded with can be re-rolled

enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc: Provides extra protection against flat damage (all armor)
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Provides extra protection against all fire/lava sources (all armor)
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Provides extra protection against explosions/explosive projectiles (all armor)
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Provides extra protection against projectiles, such as arrows (all armor)
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: If you get hit, a small amount of damage is dealt to the player/mob that hit you (all armor)
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Allows you to breathe underwater for longer (helmets)
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Allows you to mine blocks at the same speed when submerged in water (helmets)
enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de: Provides extra protection when you hit the ground from larger heights (boots)
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Allows you to swim/move around in water faster (boots)
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Allows you to walk across the surface of water by freezing the water beneath you (boots)
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Allows you to move across soul sand faster (boots)
enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc: Allows you to sneak/crouch walk faster (leggings)
enchantment.minecraft.sharpness.desc: Increases the damage against everything (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Greatly increases the damage dealt to undead mobs (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Greatly increases the damage dealt to bugs (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Increases the distance at which mobs/players get hit back when you hit them (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Lights mobs/players on fire when you hit them (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: When killing any mob, you have a chance of getting extra drops/loot (melee weapons and tools)
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Allows the sweep attack to do extra damage (swords)
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Some blocks that can drop items have a chance to give you extra drops (tools)
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Some blocks that can't be collected/blocks that turn into other blocks when mined are now able to be mined (tools)
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Provides extra damage the more you charge it up (bows)
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Provides extra knockback when hitting a mob/player (bows)
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Sets arrows on fire when shot (bows)
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Can shoot unlimited arrows, as long as 1 arrow is in your inventory (bows)
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Shoots 2 more arrows in a V shape on both sides of the middle arrow (crossbows)
enchantment.minecraft.quick_charge.desc: Allows you to charge the pullback string faster (crossbows)
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: When you throw it, it will come back to you (tridents)
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Allows the player to launch forward when in a body of water or standing in rain (tridents)
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Creates lightning when thrown at a mob, player or lightning rod as long as the sky is above them (tridents)
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Greatly increases damage dealt to underwater mobs (tridents)
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Does more damage based on how high you fall before hitting a mob/player (maces)
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: After hitting a smash attack, you will be launched into the air, consecutive attacks will keep launching you (maces)
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Uses 1 hunger bar/saturation to lunge forward when performing the jab attack (spears)
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: You have a higher chance to catch treasure (fishing rods)
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc: Can catch fish and treasure faster (fishing rods)
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Has a chance to not consume durability (tools, weapons, armor, and shields)
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: If you are holding something with mending on it, collected experience will heal the durability of the item (tools, weapons, armor, and shields)
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Locks whatever you are wearing on your body until you die (anything that can be worn)
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: When dying, anything with the Curse of Vanishing on it will disappear
